idea-plugin.name: SQLAlchemy Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Catches broken SQLAlchemy string references while you type — the ones that otherwise only fail at app startup or query time:
  • relationship("Usre") — unknown mapped class
  • back_populates="adreses" — no such attribute on the target model
  • ForeignKey("usres.id") — unknown table or column
  • secondary="user_rolez" — unknown association table
  • query(User).filter_by(nmae=...) — no such column
Plus Ctrl+click navigation and completion inside all of those strings.
